caption: A sheet of newspaper is laid over a campfire, and the paper catches, curls, blackens, and falls apart into ash.

sa.check: A campfire with flames is present.
A sheet of newspaper is laid over it.
The paper falls apart into ash or flakes.
The order is laid, catches, curls and blackens, breaks apart.

pc.expect: The burn advances outward from where flame first touches the paper; burnt areas stay black and the paper only shrinks and darkens.
pc.fail: Blackened paper turns white again; or the paper grows back or uncurls to flat; or the flame front retreats leaving unburnt paper behind; or the fire starts from a spot no flame reached.

pc.expect: Flames on the paper point upward; light flakes may lift in the hot air, but heavier pieces and ash settle down into the fire.
pc.fail: Flames point downward; or the whole sheet lifts off the fire and hangs above it; or pieces of paper fall upward away from the fire in still air.

pc.expect: Burning paper curls, blackens and thins; it does not melt into liquid or drip.
pc.fail: The paper melts and runs like plastic; or stays flat and white while flames sit on it; or turns to ash without ever blackening or curling.

pc.expect: Where the paper covers the fire the flames respond: they lick around and through it, and smoke rises from it.
pc.fail: The paper sits on the flames with no darkening, smoke or flame reaching it; or flames pass through the sheet leaving it untouched.

pc.expect: The sheet and the fire keep their identity: the paper only shrinks, the logs stay the logs; nothing appears or vanishes abruptly.
pc.fail: The paper vanishes in a single step while still whole; or a second sheet appears; or ash appears far from the paper; or logs appear, vanish or pass through each other.

pc.expect: The newsprint pattern, the logs and the surroundings stay consistent apart from the burning.
pc.fail: The print on the unburnt part changes; or the logs rearrange; or the ground changes between frames.
